incident_text: New users cannot finish KYC verification and some returning users are stuck at login checks since about 11:50.

truth.description: auth-kyc's API key for the external KYC vendor expired, so every vendor call is rejected with 401 and KYC checks fail. Nothing was deployed or reconfigured.

logs.msg: kyc vendor rejected request: 401 unauthorized, api key kyc-prod-2025 expired
kyc status unavailable for session {rid}, asking user to retry later
onboarding flow v2 served to user {rid}

trap: no change explains the fault (a credential expired); a flag rollout of a new onboarding flow lands two minutes earlier
